glossary.definition: (1) "Principally undeveloped" means a parcel of real property that is used for public, active or passive, outdoor education, recreation, or similar open space uses and contains only the structures, roadways, and other facilities that are necessary for such uses.
glossary.scope: (E) As used in divisions (C) and (D) of this section:
glossary.source_title: Section 5713.34 - Portion of tax savings on converted lands may be recouped.

glossary.definition:
(2) "Public entity" means any political subdivision of this state or any agency or instrumentality of a political subdivision.
